To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

low leakage current, high breakdown voltage, high quality SiOx films can be achieved by depositing SiOx films in a low pressure ( approximately mTorr) low energy RF discharging system at room temperature.
the leakage current and breakdown voltage of the SiOx film can be significantly enhanced by the high flux, high ion bombardment energy and low temperature deposition.
low energy ion bombardments during low temperature deposition of SiOx can improve the electrical properties of the SiOx films, such as leakage current and breakdown voltage.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the electrical properties of SiOx film deposited at low substrate temperature by using a magnetron sputtering system.
the electrical properties of SiOx film prepared by low energy RF plasma deposition.
the deposition of SiOx thin films in low energy RF plasmas with high flux ion bombardment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the leakage current is reduced and the breakdown voltage increased due to the enhanced surface processes.
the low energy ion bombardments in RF magnetron system are beneficial to obtain good electrical properties for the deposited SiOx films.
the high quality SiOx films with excellent electrical properties can be deposited by RF magnetron sputtering at room temperature.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the low energy ion bombardments in RF discharges can be used to improve the electrical properties of SiO2 films deposited at room temperature.
a low energy RF plasma system is very effective in the deposition of high quality silicon oxide films.
the low energy, high flux plasma deposition is very effective to deposit high quality SiOx films at low temperatures.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the breakdown voltage of the SiOx films is not limited by the film thickness but by the film roughness and porosity.
low energy ion bombardments during the deposition process are important to improve the film quality, especially the leakage current.
the breakdown voltage can be increased by a factor of 3.5 and the leakage current decreased by a factor of more than 100.
